widget.doc: A tinted note inside a card: a bold title and a message with an icon; tone is warning (default), danger (a risk, cannot be undone), success, accent or neutral.

props.doc: The short point, bold (This cannot be undone).
One or two sentences under it (empty: none).
accent, success, warning, danger or neutral.

box.name: toneInk
box.formula: props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.good : props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warn : props.tone == 'danger' ? theme.colors.bad : props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.inkSoft : theme.colors.accent

box.name: toneDeep
box.formula: props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.goodDeep : props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warnDeep : props.tone == 'danger' ? theme.colors.badDeep : props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.ink : theme.colors.accentDeep

box.name: toneTint
box.formula: props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.goodTint : props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warnTint : props.tone == 'danger' ? theme.colors.badTint : props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.tile : theme.colors.accentTint

box.name: toneLine
box.formula: props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.goodLine : props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warnLine : props.tone == 'danger' ? theme.colors.badLine : props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.lineStrong : theme.colors.accentLine
